description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the Markdown to Confluence content conversion, focusing on Table of Contents rendering functionality.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A simple engine class that renders content by returning the 'content' key from data array.

classes.name: Template
classes.description: A template class extending the HTML Template, providing a way to get a custom engine.

classes.name: TableOfContentsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the behavior of Markdown conversion related to Table of Contents macros.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the template by returning the content from the data array.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Returns a new Engine instance for processing content.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Sets up and returns a configuration array with a template renderer configured.

methods.name: testNoTOCByDefault
methods.description: Tests the Markdown converter output when no TOC is requested.

methods.name: testTOCToken
methods.description: Tests the conversion output when a [TOC] token is present in the Markdown.

methods.name: testShouldAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOn
methods.description: Tests if the macro is added when auto TOC setting is enabled.

methods.name: testShouldNotAddTOCWhenAutoTOCisOnAndTOCisPresent
methods.description: Tests that existing TOC tokens prevent adding additional TOC macro when auto TOC is on.
